author: mikegethyn84
quote: Firstly we're in 2026 and having to minimilise settings to try and make a game playable. 30fps is a massive issue , just waking around causes screen stutter ,gun battles are unplayable, the terrible vignette on the screen is a distraction ,the blurry graphics every time you walk even with motion off ,all terrible. Then there's the story,  a simple bowing down to an annoying women. This game was made my a bunch of woke nancies and their woke agenda is pushed out in the game constantly. You send the first ten hours trying to make a women happy ,what a pathetic game . The characters are soulless and annoying, there's no humor, full of glitches, it's just trash . No where near the level expected and a real chore to play ,if you can play it at all as the screen stutter makes and constant random blurs make it unplayable anyway . Adding to all this ,the game is digital only so you cant even send it back for a refund is bigger than any robbery in the game . The real robbers here are rockstar and it's woke brigade staff, they've robbed gamers of something they've been looking forward to over a decade ,and they've robbed them financially when we've paid for something we don't even own and can't refund . Shame on you rockstar.
